note: Concepts are derived from the repo's own vocabulary — the FAMILY dict, strategy-card frontmatter, docs/trading-signals-concept-family.md, and terms verified to recur in the corpus. A concept matching no file is dropped, not kept.

concepts.label: Risk rails and dry-run safety
concepts.why: The extension can place real orders. Dry-run is the default, rails live in code and fail closed, and a fresh install must never be able to trade.

concepts.label: Lookahead and fill timing
concepts.why: A signal at bar t may use data only through t. Centred indicators, same-bar fills and displaced clouds are the recurring hazards.

concepts.label: On-chain execution reality
concepts.why: Oracle-priced perps, priority fees as a product, per-account fee markets, dropped-versus-reverted. Decides whether a strategy is executable at all.

concepts.label: Strategy family: regime-filter
concepts.why: A value of the FAMILY dict in backtester/core/strategies/__init__.py, which is the repo's own taxonomy rather than one imposed here.

concepts.label: Strategy family: trend
concepts.why: A value of the FAMILY dict in backtester/core/strategies/__init__.py, which is the repo's own taxonomy rather than one imposed here.

concepts.label: Evidence floor
concepts.why: Below a minimum trade count a result is not eligible to be reported as an improvement. cpcv_evaluate prints DROPPED but still returns paths, which is how a 6-trade Sharpe reached a headline.

concepts.label: Grid trading
concepts.why: A resting grid converts a sustained trend into a maximum-size losing position; the re-centring gate fired once in 1,875 bars.

concepts.label: Data integrity
concepts.why: Gaps refused rather than filled, columns resolved by name, timestamps monotone. A concatenated XRP series hides a 2.5-year join.

concepts.label: Buy-and-hold benchmark
concepts.why: Zero parameters, and it out-ranked all but one or two strategies on SOL and all five recommended configurations on ZEC.

concepts.label: Strategy family: baseline
concepts.why: A value of the FAMILY dict in backtester/core/strategies/__init__.py, which is the repo's own taxonomy rather than one imposed here.

concepts.label: Cost model
concepts.why: Fees and slippage are never optional and must be applied exactly once. The engine runs fee_bps=6.0, slippage_bps=2.0, fill_delay=1.

concepts.label: Combinatorial purged cross-validation
concepts.why: The repo's primary evaluation method: 8 blocks, k=2, up to 28 paths. Replaced the single 70/30 split, whose in-sample window ended on the highest close in the series.

concepts.label: Strategy family: mean-reversion
concepts.why: A value of the FAMILY dict in backtester/core/strategies/__init__.py, which is the repo's own taxonomy rather than one imposed here.

concepts.label: Overfitting and PBO
concepts.why: PBO measured 0.700 at daily horizons against a 0.500 noise line, so in-sample rank is anti-informative. This is the finding that governs how every other number here may be read.

concepts.label: Perturbation and robustness
concepts.why: Second independent axis beside CPCV: nudge each parameter +/-10% and re-run. A point that collapses is a spike, not a plateau.

concepts.label: Cross-asset and cross-timeframe transfer
concepts.why: The same 25 strategies score 25/25 on BTC daily and 0/25 on SOL hourly. The dataset has repeatedly explained more than the strategy.
